rules: Use uppercase for short English labels only
One screen should have only one visual headline
Use no more than two font sizes per screen
Avoid anti-aliased fonts when the panel is physically small

input.rotate: selection, tuning, orbit speed, energy accumulation

feedback.rotate_slow: one orbit point moves; thin edge cursor
feedback.rotate_medium: two orbit points move; energy ticks appear
feedback.rotate_fast: three orbit points move; orbit spacing compresses

implementation_constraints: Draw cat and clover with primitives or 1-bit sprites, not large PNGs
Keep most of the background unchanged between frames
Use deterministic motion; do not randomize stars each frame
Update only the center region if RAM is limited
Prefer 1-bit masks with palette recoloring for icons
Do not use alpha blending on MCU unless already supported
